meta.name: Deadlock mods not working
meta.title: Deadlock Mods Not Working After an Update? Fixes | Deadlock Mod Manager
meta.description: Deadlock mods stopped loading or the game crashes after a patch? Fix gameinfo.gi resets, outdated HUD mods, conflicts and mod manager issues step by step.

afterUpdate.question: Why did my Deadlock mods stop working after an update?
afterUpdate.answer: Deadlock updates usually overwrite gameinfo.gi, which removes the line that tells the game to load the addons folder. Launch modded from Deadlock Mod Manager to add it back, or re-add it by hand.

crash.question: Why does Deadlock crash after a patch with mods installed?
crash.answer: Outdated HUD and UI mods are the most common cause. Disable them, launch, and turn them back on one at a time once their authors have released updates.

manager.question: Why is Deadlock Mod Manager not working?
manager.answer: Update to the latest version first. If the app can't find the game, set the Deadlock folder in Settings. On Linux Flatpak builds, a grey screen or folder-picker crash has documented workarounds in the troubleshooting docs.

reinstall.question: Do I have to reinstall my mods after every Deadlock update?
reinstall.answer: No. Your .vpk files stay in the addons folder. Usually only gameinfo.gi needs fixing, and the app does that each time you launch modded.

hero.title: Deadlock mods not working after an update?
hero.intro: Most breakages after a Valve patch come down to three things: a reset gameinfo.gi, outdated HUD mods, or two mods fighting over the same files. Here is how to fix each one.

steps.updateApp: Update Deadlock Mod Manager to the latest version from the <link>download page</link>.
steps.updateMods: Check for mod updates in the Mods Library.
steps.disableHud: Disable HUD and UI mods, then use Launch modded.
steps.reenable: Re-enable mods one at a time to find any that still break.

ignored.title: The game ignores every mod
ignored.cause: A Deadlock update or Steam's file verification replaced gameinfo.gi, so the addons folder is no longer loaded.
ignored.fix: Open Deadlock Mod Manager and use Launch modded; it re-applies the search path every time. Installed by hand? Add the two lines from the install guide back into gameinfo.gi.

crash.title: Crash on launch, or the HUD is broken
crash.cause: UI and HUD mods replace interface files Valve just changed. Old files clash with the new game.
crash.fix: Disable HUD and quality-of-life mods first, then launch. Check for mod updates in the Mods Library and re-enable them once they're updated.

partial.title: Some mods work, others don't
partial.cause: Two enabled mods change the same files and only one of them can load.
partial.fix: Open the conflicts view in Mods Library, pick which mod should win and change the load order.

stuck.title: A mod stays stuck downloading or installing
stuck.cause: An interrupted download or a file the game was holding open.
stuck.fix: Close Deadlock, remove the stuck mod with its trash icon and install it again. Still stuck? Use Clear All Mods in Settings, then Analyze Local Addons to re-add what's on disk.

accessDenied.title: "Access is denied" (os error 5) on Windows
accessDenied.cause: gameinfo.gi or the addons folder is read-only.
accessDenied.fix: Right-click the file or folder, open Properties and untick Read-only. If an old mod was installed with admin rights, run the manager as administrator once to remove it.

steamLaunch.title: Mods vanish when launching from Steam
steamLaunch.cause: The app's auto-reset option removes the mod paths when you quit, so Steam launches vanilla.
steamLaunch.fix: That's intended. Launch from Deadlock Mod Manager to play modded, or turn the option off in Settings.

errors.title: Seeing a specific error?
errors.intro: Each of these has its own step-by-step fix.

stillStuck.title: Still stuck?
stillStuck.body: The <docs>troubleshooting docs</docs> cover Linux, Flatpak and Steam Deck issues in detail. You can also ask on <discord>Discord</discord>, where the community usually knows which mods broke with the latest patch.
